name: DragonSwordWorldRadar
renderer: WinForms source compiled in memory by Windows PowerShell 5.1
automatic_start: hidden WScript watcher using a TEMP working directory; transient PowerShell host only while the game is running
data_installation: local game PAK extraction through in-memory C# and the ooz.exe decoder
game_update_detection: stored executable/PAK fingerprint checked on each game launch
boss_runtime_tracking: tb_actor_respawn read from consistent .db/.bak plus WAL/SHM/journal snapshots; no Character enumeration
boss_marker: single enlarged vector marker modeled on Icon_Mark_FieldBoss_Sprite and shared by all bosses
pawn_tracking: Current PlayerController.Pawn sampled directly; no Lua-wrapper identity comparison
bridge_protocol: alternating static JSON plus compact sequence-validated motion slots
treasure_marker_outline: DrawEllipse and reusable GraphicsPath outlines use the shared neutral dark RadarMarkerStyle.Outline
background_visibility: overlay remains active and visible after F7 until F8; no foreground, overlap, or minimized-window visibility polling
runtime_probe_hooks: none; exploration probes are isolated in DragonSwordWorldDataProbe
installer_overlay_validation: Install.ps1 and the Windows CI gate compile the exact complete overlay source set used by the F7 host under Windows PowerShell 5.1
config_validation: malformed preserved config.lua is archived and replaced by a validated complete default

marker_style.nearest_marker: larger diameter; no purple selection ring
marker_style.anti_aliasing: disabled only for treasure geometry to avoid transparency-key fringe

refactor.motion_parser: reusable per-slot candidate buffers/models with direct 21-field ASCII parsing and isolated reusable published MotionFrame/WorldMapState instances
refactor.world_rendering: single projection pass with reusable winding paths, pixel dedupe, projected-marker storage, and transactional double-buffered per-map visibility indexes
refactor.save_state_publication: immutable copy-on-write treasure, boss, alias, and ignore snapshots; consistent opened-state capture; native SQLCipher callback exception containment; load-token invalidation
refactor.render_resources: retained boss and height-indicator GDI resources plus one shared neutral treasure-outline pen
refactor.boss_availability: maintenance-cached next-availability deadlines with deadline-transition invalidation

reliability.compile_gate: Windows PowerShell 5.1 Add-Type compilation is mandatory in Verify-Source.ps1 and Install.ps1
reliability.module_fault_isolation: save state, catalog, visibility index, boss availability, diagnostics, and renderer failures are isolated and rate-limited in the overlay log
reliability.catalog_publication: catalog and override replacements publish only after before/after file stamp consistency checks
reliability.visibility_index_publication: replacement per-map index is built in staging and swapped only after a complete successful rebuild
reliability.native_callback_boundary: managed SQLCipher row callback exceptions are captured before returning through sqlite3
reliability.adaptive_scheduler: active/idle timer transitions are driven only by published visual changes; no protocol fields were added
reliability.codedom_scope_compatibility: local variables use unique names across nested method scopes for Windows PowerShell 5.1 CodeDOM

performance.motion_sampling: 24 ms in minimap and world-map modes; compact records are written only after a visual delta or a 1000 ms heartbeat
performance.bridge_reads: FileInfo stamp gates prevent opening unchanged motion and static slots
performance.redraw_policy: heartbeat-only motion frames and visually equivalent static states do not invalidate the form
performance.render_batching: non-nearest minimap and world-map treasure markers are grouped into four retained GraphicsPath batches with one smoothing-state scope
performance.process_tracking: overlay geometry, lifetime checks, and save polling reuse a validated tracked PID before enumerating processes
